An additional impact would be greatly curtailed revenues to the Burlington Northern Railroad.
Coal Conveyor System
Construction of coal conveyor systems could be a viable alternative for transport of coal from the mine pit area to coal preparation, storage and train load-out facilities. Coal conveyor systems are also feasible as an alternative to railroad spur line transport over distances as great as 15 miles.
Land requirements for a conveyor system would approximate or exceed those necessary for a truck haul road or railroad spur line. However, crossing of rights-of-way by traffic or animals would be restricted by above-grade conveyor equipment. The continuously operating mechanical equipment would have to be enclosed or completely isolated by fencing or other suitable means to eliminate a hazard to the environment. Nearby residents would definitely be cognizant of the noise and dust problems associated with this equipment.
